component.name: Videos
component.summary: Modular media player for the Aelum desktop

description.p: Plays video and audio through libmpv behind a GNOME-style interface: a header bar and a playback toolbar; in fullscreen the same controls float over the video and fade when the pointer goes idle. Files can be dropped on the window, and the player reopens where you left off.

ul.li: New app icon: a stacked-cards design in the desktop's dark color scheme.
The buttons beside the play button now skip chapters; the toolbar's skip buttons switch files.
Those chapter buttons appear only for a title that actually has chapters.
Skip and chapter tooltips now name exactly what each control does, in all 28 languages.
The interface now hides itself when the pointer has been idle in a windowed player too, and while a title is paused; a player with nothing loaded keeps its controls.
New pin button in the playback bar keeps the player above every other window in Hyprland, so a video can play while you work elsewhere; it stays marked in the accent color while the window is pinned.
The launcher's short description (GenericName and Comment) is now translated into all 28 supported languages.
Fast volume scrolling registers every notch; rapid steps are no longer dropped.
The volume keeps values above 100 instead of the playbar slider pulling it back down.
